visual_review: Direct original review shows gray cylindrical roof tiles and round tile ends on a curved entrance eave, blue/green/gold painted brackets and lintel, dark red timber posts, two red hanging lanterns, red blossom branches and whitewash at the edges. The entrance is open, with another roof and the 妙音香界 plaque visible inside. The primary gallery identifies Longcui; no legible Longcui name is visible in this frame. It supports the gateway structure and material separation. The crop excludes the lower gate and ground: no six-metre frontage, 2.1-metre opening, closed door leaves, floor/collision geometry, original historical construction or night lighting is established.
